method.batched_check: a selected batched rule is kept only if it beats the best core rule beyond its grid search (parametric bootstrap, alpha 0.05)
method.likelihood: Mallows on Kendall distance, theta >= 0 by maximum likelihood, one theta per unit
method.rule_vs_random: permutation test of the AIC gap to random, positions permuted within batch-blocks; rule declared at p < 0.05
method.selection: AIC; batched counts theta, w and one phase per validator
